title: Stochastic Maximum Principle for McKean-Vlasov Control with Discrete Path Dependence
summary: We study a class of McKean-Vlasov control problems with discrete path dependence. The coefficients and cost functional may depend on finitely many past values of the controlled state, observed at fixed deterministic times, and on their joint law. We establish well-posedness of the controlled state equation and derive necessary and sufficient optimality conditions through a stochastic Pontryagin maximum principle.
